name: Hernández de Córdoba to Yucatán
traveler: Francisco Hernández de Córdoba and Bernal Díaz
summary: Sailing from Cuba to seize captives to enslave, three ships reach instead the coast of Yucatán, with stone towns and temples larger than anything in the islands. They are beaten off at Champotón; the news of a rich civilization sends Grijalva and then Cortés.

stops.note: A town they call 'Great Cairo' for its size.
Temples and painted walls; they are told to leave.
Attacked by Maya warriors; half the men are killed and Córdoba is mortally wounded.
Driven to Florida looking for water.
Córdoba dies of his wounds; his report spreads through Cuba.
